This change doesn't fix the problem.  The metrics_portable.py file also has a dependency on tensorflow.  It includes the following line:

    from tensorflow.lite.python import metrics_interface

Which breaks on Raspberry Pi.

Thanks.  It now runs on my Pi without modification.

https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/tree/master/tensorflow/lite/tools/pip_package
